mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.3% and UNRATE declines by more than 0.2pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO growth < 0), a decline in industrial production signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines in supply contraction regimes, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 230 signals elevated inflation, prompting concerns about monetary tightening and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 235 signals persistent high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in CPIAUCSL signal a proactive monetary response to inflation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through improved market sentiment.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.5% over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1% and CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
